capabilities: Share the open note, current headings, and selected text with Claude Code sessions
Write reading context to a state file that a Claude Code hook adds to prompts
Pause or resume sharing from the status bar, command palette, or settings
Limit context sharing to sessions in the vault or its git project, or share with all sessions
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only; one vault at a time; reading-view line numbers rely on non-public Obsidian internals. Detailed privacy section: the plugin makes no network requests, and context is sent to Anthropic only via the Claude Code prompt.
intentEvidence: Claude Code's VS Code extension tells Claude which file you have open and what you selected. This does the same
motivation: The author wanted Obsidian to work like Claude Code's VS Code extension, which already tells Claude which file is open and what is selected.
problem: Claude Code sessions know nothing about what you are reading in Obsidian, so you must manually paste note text and explain where you are.

relations.evidence: Ask Claude Code about the note you are reading without pasting it in.
obsidian-context, a Claude Code plugin | Claude Code | adds that to your prompt

requires.name: Claude Code with the obsidian-context plugin

summary: Context-sharing plugin that sends your current note, section, and text selection to Claude Code so you can ask about them without pasting.
